formula: rotate-half over the WHOLE head, pairs (i, i+d/2), angle = pos*f[i], i < d/2. default: f[i] = theta^(-2i/d). proportional: r = int(partial*d/2); f[i] = theta^(-2i/d) for i < r else 0 (dims i and i+d/2 with i >= r pass through unchanged). y[i] = x[i]cos a - x[i+d/2]sin a; y[i+d/2] = x[i+d/2]cos a + x[i]sin a
